subject: reps API you'll call, and the rep log
body: Planned API: reps.script(profile, emotionId, kind?), reps.run(profile, emotionId, trigger, {onStep, clock, speech}) -> {session: Promise<RepSession>, stop(reason)}, reps.status(profile, sessions) per emotion (conditioning|ready-to-test|installed|no-anchor), reps.progress(sessions) for the progress screen (reps per emotion, intensity trend, recovery cue vs sham, installed). Reps does not persist: proposal is that experience stores the RepSession log in browser storage and passes it back in. Two questions: which emotion fires on a detection (the one picked on the live screen?), and will you show the stop control for the whole rep? I'll ship a seeded rep-history fixture so the demo can install one emotion live.
